{{Youmay|the acronym|the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Tiny.f]]}}
'''TINYF''' was an acronym for "'''Thaere Is Not Your Friend'''." The slogan was graffitied over the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and soon began appearing on badges and pins woren by the citizens of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
